user.title: Flat climate
user.description: Connects to your building's app API. All three values come from one captured app request: `POST <API URL>/<flat id>/bacnet/read` with the header `X-Session-Id: <session id>`. The session stays valid while it is used; Home Assistant uses it every minute.

reauth_confirm.title: New session id needed
reauth_confirm.description: The API no longer accepts the saved session id. Log in to the app again, capture its X-Session-Id header and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The API rejected this session id.
error.unknown_flat: The API answered but returned nothing for this flat id.
error.not_https: The API URL must start with https://

abort.already_configured: This flat is already set up.
